name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Q&A platform for community forums, help centers and team knowledge bases, auto-installed on a bundled PostgreSQL database with a generated admin account.

alerts.message: Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@example.com by default) and the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Set ADMIN_EMAIL to your own address before the first deploy: the admin account is created only on the first start, and changing its email later needs SMTP for the confirmation link. Email notifications and sign-up verification also need SMTP, configured in the admin panel.
